summary: Adds canvas card create: a create_card transform operation that builds real affine:note cards through the gated Y.js write layer.
reason: Agents had no first-class card creation primitive and were falling back to disposable local helpers without the canvas write gates. create_card joins the closed transform allowlist so it inherits pre-integrity, backup/state vector, post-local integrity, delta push, reload verification and post-integrity, and every created block carries sys:children as a Y.Array.
validated_outcome: go build ./... , go vet ./... and go test ./... (320 tests) with unit coverage for the validator, the Y.Array construction probe, frame registration and UTF-8 round trip. Not exercised against a live AFFiNE board.
